originality.rationale: The defining and sequel papers cover general cut-complex methods and other graph families, not this dimension-uniform cube formula. The published Q3 instance is credited; published Q4 total cut uses another functor; an edge-disjoint-square theorem excludes the cubes. No searched equivalent or dominating result was found, with residual risk explicitly acknowledged.
residual_risks: Equivalent unindexed results phrased as cubical theta complexes or Stanley-Reisner ideals may exist.

value.rationale: The formula classifies the full integral homology of a natural infinite family, supplies the dual integral homotopy type and a structural explanation for two adjacent homological dimensions, and proves nonshellability in every dimension. The d=4 case is the first new cubical case; it is not a routine recalculation of the known d=3 complex.
